targets.evidence_quote:
Following this notion, the present study provides a wide replication (Walker et al., 2019) of the

targets.outcome_quote: The replication's results do not confirm the findings outlined by Riccucci et al. (2016). In the present study, symbolic gender representation does not affect the willingness to co-produce. Equivalence testing (Lakens, 2017) indicates null findings based on the absence of meaningful treatment effects.
